note: Original findings are in raw/go-tests-rest.md; entries carry id, title, and verdict fields.

verdicts.title: hand-rolled ProviderAdapter fakes
verdicts.note: Counts understated: 131 'func (..) Complete(' in 103 non-agent test files (some may be non-adapter). agenttest lives in agent/internal and is imported only from agent/*; llm is a separate module so llm/llmtest is viable. Overlaps with agent audit; needs Jesse OK on new package.

verdicts.title: cov_* replay matrices
verdicts.note: Counts verified (40 files, 6031 lines, 46 Fuzz, 350 '_ =' lines, 246 Fatal/Error). But coverage.md explicitly documents these as EXECUTED-not-TESTED panic nets by design, so it is a known tradeoff, not drift. Deleting call sites reduces coverage, which Jesse's rules rank worse than failing tests.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Do not delete. Opportunistically upgrade call sites to assertions (as cov_auth_instances_fuzz_test.go does) when touching a subsystem; remove a production seam var only if it has no behavior-test user. Any floor change needs Jesse's agreement.

verdicts.title: stale file:line citations in coverage tests
verdicts.note: Verified: jsonrpc_coverage_test.go:8 cites jsonrpc.go:123-136 but Kind is at jsonrpc.go:101; types_covtest_test.go:20 cites types.go:696 but ClientMutationTurnID is types.go:1951; app_auth_credentialjson_guard_test.go:25 cites app_auth.go:491 which is an unrelated comment. Comment-stripping is mechanical and safe; folding tests is optional.

verdicts.title: duplicate waitFor/waitUntil helpers and raw sleeps
verdicts.note: waitFor/waitUntil at cmd/evener-dev/modulelint_wave_test.go:20, app_models_test.go:933, sshconn/manager_test.go:2922, appserver/websocket_worker_queue_test.go:108 (plus agent/session_lossless_events_test.go:785) with differing arg order. 292 time.Sleep in 164 files repo-wide. app_host_admin_test.go has 19 sleeps. Module boundary caveat is real: agent/llm modules cannot import a root-module package.

verdicts.title: git fixture helpers copied
verdicts.note: Repo-wide 61 exec.Command("git") in 46 test files; runGit/newLinkedWorktree/gitIn copies found in buildinfo, cmdutil, identifier, launchconfig, sshconn, plugins, agent/*. Only 16 files set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/NOSYSTEM. identifier and agent are separate modules, so a root-module gittest cannot cover all; scope accordingly.

verdicts.note: 1307 WebConfig{ vs 285 NewWebServer( in cmd/evener-hub tests. newTestWebServer (webnext_test.go:17) uses bare hubcore.WebConfig{} while newHubRPCTestServerWithWeb defaults roots to t.TempDir() with a comment explaining the shared-HOME race. verdicts.title: error text as test oracle
verdicts.note: Repo-wide strings.Contains(err.Error() is far larger than claimed: 1341 hits in 374 test files (includes agent/). Direction and tooling (evener dev copy-oracle) valid; AGENTS.md explicitly forbids this pattern. Convert per area, no sentinel invention without need.

verdicts.title: sshconn fake runner parses command text
verdicts.note: Verified 435 runFn refs in 79 files, 91 'systemctl restart' hits, and fakes_test.go requireProtocolUpgrade matching `mv "$tmp"` / evener-install.XXXXXX. The plan to export operation kinds from production adds production API purely for tests; prefer test-only classification first.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Add a test-only fakeHost with an argv-to-operation classifier in fakes_test.go and port manager/version/deploy tests in slices; only add production exports if a caller genuinely needs them. Keep real-shell remoteinstall script tests.
